narrative.overview: Picture a midnight observatory where your whole record is kept. The visual language is Huly's: a near-black void, graphite surfaces, pill controls and hairline edges. One electric iris blue and one ember coral tell the whole colour story. The aurora beam appears once per page, and here it reads as light leaking out of a vault door. Night is the native mode; in day mode the content bands turn white, but the spectacle stays dark in both themes through the .band-void scope. Nothing on screen may look like a statistic, a testimonial or a real person unless it is one.
keyCharacteristics: Iris blue and ember coral are the only accents; everything else is graphite, white and grey.
Every button, chip, toggle and nav item is a full pill (9999px). Fields get 4px corners, cards 12px, large dark panels 30px.
Semantic tokens (bg, surface, ink, line, danger, success) change between day and night. The raw palette stays the same.
Dark spectacle bands alternate with content bands that follow the theme.
One custom line-icon set and one vault-dial mark. No emoji or unicode glyphs stand in for icons.
Motion is slow and expo-eased, and it is reduced or switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Iris and ember are the only accent colours. Add no third accent, and no status colours beyond danger and success.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Inside components, use ink, surface, line and the other semantic tokens, never raw hex, unless the element is meant to look the same in both themes.

rules.name: The Void Band Rule
rules.body: A section that must stay dark in both themes gets .band-void, which re-declares every night token for everything inside it.

rules.name: The Display Floor Rule
rules.body: General Sans is only for display text at 28px and up. Nav, buttons, labels and body text always use Inter.

rules.name: The Borders-Not-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Dark cards are set apart by hairline borders and surface colour steps, not drop shadows.

dos: Do use the semantic tokens so every screen works in day and night.
Do wrap any always-dark section in .band-void.
Do use exactly one .btn-primary per screen, and .btn-white for CTAs on dark bands.
Do take every icon from icons.tsx.
Do label sample content visibly as sample or example.
Do give every animation a finished reduced-motion state.
donts: Don't invent statistics, user counts, success rates, logos, testimonials or quotes.
Don't add a third accent colour or use ember as a button fill.
Don't use unicode glyphs, emoji or third-party icon sets as icons.
Don't show the aurora beam more than once per page.
Don't use General Sans below 28px or for interface text.
Don't replay the VaultDoor on normal navigation.
